caption: A magnet is moved toward a steel saucepan on the counter, and the magnet jumps the last gap and clicks onto the pan.

sa.check: A steel saucepan on a counter.
A magnet is moved toward the pan.
The magnet jumps the last gap and lands on the pan.
The magnet stays on the pan when released.
The magnet is moved by hand until the last gap, then jumps on its own.
The order is approach, jump, hold.

pc.expect: The magnet moves only in the hand until the last small gap, jumps that gap onto the pan, and then stays still on it.
pc.fail: The magnet jumps from far away; or slides about on the pan after landing; or springs off the pan with nothing pulling it; or the pan slides toward the magnet.

pc.expect: Over the last small gap the magnet is drawn onto the pan and stays pressed to it with nothing else holding it once the hand withdraws.
pc.fail: The magnet stops a gap short of the pan and hangs there; or drops when the hand lets go; or slides down the pan's side; or bounces off and falls.

pc.expect: The jump is toward the pan along the line between them, and the magnet stops on contact.
pc.fail: The magnet jumps away from the pan; or darts sideways past it; or slides toward and away several times before settling; or keeps moving over the pan's surface after landing.

pc.expect: The pan stays where it is on the counter; nothing else on the counter moves.
pc.fail: The pan slides or tips as the magnet lands; or the lid rattles or lifts; or other items on the counter shift.

pc.expect: One magnet on one pan; the magnet touches the pan's surface and does not sink in; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The magnet sinks into the pan; or a second magnet appears; or the magnet vanishes; or the hand passes through the pan.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour, the pan's finish and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or the pan changes colour; or the counter's contents rearrange.

note: The click is sound and is not judged.
